originalSourceObject.name: Martial Adept
originalSourceObject.description: You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat maneuvers.
originalSourceObject.effect: Learn two maneuvers from the Battle Master archetype, gain one superiority die (d6)

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: The literal Battle Master archetype/superiority-die source has no matching current class-card menu. NEW use the six feat-only maneuver definitions below, each fully specified from existing ordinary actions with a finite die spend. At acquisition permanently choose two different maneuverIDs; gain a separate pool of one superiorityd6, initially available and recovered on completedSR orLR. One die can fund only one declared maneuver on one event; noRP/RC/class-resource exchange or conversion. All maneuvers pay their own actual Action/BA/Reaction or attack-replacement timing, with ordinary target/body legality. A committed attempt spends its die even on miss/failure/countering; illegal attempts spend nothing. The rolled result is used only as the selected maneuver states, not free damage on every maneuver. It grants no Soldier Coordinated Maneuver, class levels or Battle Master subclass. Choices cannot be changed for free at rest.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Explicit NEW six-maneuver feat menu, two permanent choices and oneSRd6 pool.
submittedWorkedCases: Choose Measured Strike and Guarding Deflection; spending the one die on either leaves none for the other before a legal rest.
A Soldier's independent resource cannot be spent as this superiority die, nor does the feat acquire Coordinated Maneuver.

originalSourceObject.name: Martial Adept (Advanced)
originalSourceObject.effect: You learn two additional maneuvers and gain one more superiority die.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require exact martialAdept. Choose two additional distinct entries from that same six-maneuver menu, excluding the two already known; permanent choices. Increase the common feat superiority pool capacity by one die of the same sized6, for two total; NEW the newly granted die begins available on actual acquisition, not each rest or retarget. CompletedSR/LR restores the shared pool to its current capacity once. Known maneuver count becomes four, not four copies of one option. No larger die, additional class resource, extraAction, simultaneous multiple-die payment or free retraining. Same underlying event may still use at most one superiority maneuver unless a future expressly priced source overrides it.

completeCurrentSupplementGroup.decision: Adopt all six NEW feat-only maneuvers and their actual die/action/target/DC limits; no Warrior/Soldier maneuver feature or extra full Action is granted.

original.name: Measured Strike
original.activation: Within one actual weapon attack, before its attack roll
original.procedure: Roll the spentd6 and add it to that one attack roll. Choose before seeing the d20/outcome; natural1 still misses and no extra critical range is created. It adds no damage and supplies no attack, target permission or extra Action.
original.basis: NEW attack-check enhancement; not an imported Battle Master maneuver.

original.name: Driving Shove
original.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary Shove
original.cost: One superiorityd6 plus the replaced attack
original.procedure: Before both opposed rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to yourSTR Athletics total for that one ordinary Shove. Target choosesAthletics/Acrobatics; tie preserves state. Actual reach/one-size-larger cap applies; success still pushes5ft away OR Prone, never both solely from this maneuver. It adds no damage.
original.basis: NEW finite bonus on reviewed ordinary Shove; printed feat/class save-based Shoves are not this maneuver.

original.name: Disarming Feint
original.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary opposed Disarm
original.procedure: Choose a reachable actually held droppable item and an ordinary legal Athletics or weapon-check Disarm. Before rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to your one opposed total; defender usesAthletics/Acrobatics, tie preserves state. Success uses the existing adjacent/own-space drop placement, not automatic custody. No damage, severed bond or proficiency grant. The save-based Disarm feat and Whip Control are separate procedures and do not acquire this bonus.
original.basis: NEW finite die on reviewed ordinary Disarm only.

original.name: Guarding Deflection
original.activation: Reaction when one direct damage event would damage you
original.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Reaction
original.procedure: After passive defenses but before tempHP, spend/roll1d6 to reduce that whole resolved event by its face, minimum0. Allocate across stable native component order. Attached conditions remain. No re-mitigation of transfer packets that forbid recipient mitigation, HP sacrifice, state assignment or direct death. It neither changes a hit to a miss nor qualifies as Riposte's successful Parry.
original.basis: NEW finite physical defense using current whole-event/damage-provenance interface.

original.name: Measured Advance
original.activation: Bonus Action on your own regular turn
original.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual BA
original.procedure: Spend/roll1d6, gaining a separate movement-cost budget of5×face feet resolved immediately. Use one already available movement mode with nonzeroSpeed, pay normal terrain/crawl/squeeze costs, respect legal endpoints and provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. No teleport, new movement mode, free Disengage, replenished ordinary movement or banked distance. Interrupted unspent distance is lost.
original.basis: NEW bounded movement procedure; no copied Soldier grant.

original.name: Rallying Signal
original.activation: Action under the ordinary Rally procedure
original.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Action
original.procedure: Choose one actual ally within30ft able to perceive the rally and one active source-qualifiedFrightened record. Before rolling the ordinaryCHA task check at its sourceDC (otherwise10), spend/roll thed6 and add its face to the total. Apply actual task degrees/natural shift; success ends only that selected record. NoHP/tempHP, loyalty, extra save, new ally turn or automatic cure of other fear records.
original.basis: NEW finite die on current reviewed Rally.
